tours.title: Luxury Waterfront Villa
tours.description: Experience this stunning 5-bedroom waterfront villa with panoramic ocean views. This modern masterpiece features floor-to-ceiling windows, a gourmet kitchen, infinity pool, and private dock. Perfect for families seeking luxury coastal living.
tours.shortDescription: Stunning 5-bedroom waterfront villa with panoramic ocean views and modern amenities.

tours.title: The Grand Restaurant
tours.description: Take a virtual tour of The Grand Restaurant, an upscale dining experience featuring elegant décor, private dining rooms, and a stunning rooftop terrace. Our 360° tour lets potential diners explore every corner before making their reservation.
tours.shortDescription: Upscale dining experience with elegant décor and rooftop terrace.

tours.title: Mountain View Resort & Spa
tours.description: Discover the serene beauty of Mountain View Resort & Spa through our immersive virtual tour. Explore luxurious suites, world-class spa facilities, infinity pools, and breathtaking mountain vistas that await your arrival.
tours.shortDescription: Serene mountain resort with world-class spa facilities and stunning views.

tours.title: Tech Innovation Hub
tours.description: Step inside the Tech Innovation Hub, a state-of-the-art coworking space designed for startups and creative professionals. Explore modern workstations, collaboration areas, meeting rooms, and recreation zones.
tours.shortDescription: State-of-the-art coworking space for startups and creative professionals.

tours.title: Historic Art Museum
tours.description: Experience centuries of art and culture in our virtual museum tour. Navigate through galleries featuring Renaissance masterpieces, contemporary installations, and rotating exhibitions from artists around the world.
tours.shortDescription: Virtual museum tour featuring Renaissance masterpieces and contemporary art.

tours.title: Premier Auto Showroom
tours.description: Browse our extensive collection of luxury vehicles from the comfort of your home. Our 360° showroom tour lets you explore every vehicle inside and out, view specifications, and schedule test drives.
tours.shortDescription: Luxury auto showroom with extensive vehicle collection.

services.title: 360° Photography
services.description: Professional 360-degree photography services using state-of-the-art equipment. We capture every angle of your space with stunning clarity and detail, creating immersive experiences that engage your audience.

services.title: Virtual Tour Creation
services.description: Transform your 360° photos into fully interactive virtual tours. We add hotspots, navigation, information cards, and custom branding to create engaging experiences that showcase your space.

services.title: 3D Dollhouse Views
services.description: Create stunning 3D dollhouse views that give viewers a complete overview of your space. Perfect for real estate listings, allowing buyers to understand the full layout at a glance.
services.shortDescription: 3D dollhouse views for complete space overview.

services.title: Drone 360° Aerials
services.description: Capture breathtaking aerial 360° views with our professional drone services. Showcase properties, landscapes, and venues from stunning perspectives that ground photography cannot achieve.
services.shortDescription: Stunning aerial 360° photography with professional drones.

services.title: Google Street View
services.description: Get your business on Google Street View and Google Maps. We are certified Google Street View photographers who can help increase your online visibility and attract more customers.

services.title: VR Experience
services.description: Take your virtual tours to the next level with VR-ready experiences. Compatible with all major VR headsets, providing fully immersive exploration of your spaces.
